## Change

Describe the Calorify feature or defect and link the related issue.

## Acceptance and verification

- [ ] I checked the feature or reproduced and verified the reported fix.
- [ ] I ran the relevant automated tests and recorded the result.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and release notes.
- [ ] A second developer reviewed the change and I addressed their feedback.

For a release PR to `main`, link the staging run and QA verification. Describe any data migration and the recovery steps it requires.
